name: Connection Technology Systems Inc.
summary: Established in 1998 and headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan, Connection Technology Systems Inc. (CTS) is a company dedicated to designing, producing, and distributing advanced network solutions. Its comprehensive portfolio includes a range of fiber optic equipment, such as fiber access, Ethernet, and CPE switches, as well as fiber residential gateways and various media converters, available in standalone, compact, and home sizes. Additionally, CTS provides Wi-Fi routers, robust industrial Power over Ethernet (PoE) and Ethernet switches, industrial PoE converters, and other industrial-grade converters. The company also supplies essential accompanying components, including SFP transceivers, lightning protection devices, external battery backups, industrial power supplies, and fiber cable trays.
